generator: crypthix-vector-gen, seeded test-rng stream, independent section 7 code

SmallFile.description: A file no longer than the 64 KiB minimum is one chunk; an empty file has none. `lengths` lists every chunk.

CutPoints.description: FastCDC 2020 at level 2 with the vault's gear table: strict mask below 256 KiB, loose to 1 MiB, a cut before the matching byte, never at an odd last byte.

CutEdges.description: Files found by search so a cut sits on an edge of the rule: at the minimum and one past it, at the switch from the strict to the loose mask (a loose-only match at 2⌊center/2⌋ cuts, one at 2⌊center/2⌋ − 1 does not), at the last position tested, an odd last byte that would match if it were tested, a repeated pattern that is cut only at the maximum, and a file between the average and the maximum where no position matches, so it is one chunk. The generator checks each with its one-byte chunker.

KeyedGear.description: Another chunker_seed gives another gear table and other boundaries for the same data.

SecretFixed.description: A secret-class object is cut into 1 MiB chunks and a shorter last one, from its length alone, with no gear-table lookup; an empty one has none.

Padme.description: padme(L) for L ≥ 2 rounds L up to a multiple of 2^(E−S); below 2 it is L.

InnerOk.description: A well-formed inner plaintext: comp 0 or 1, rsv 0, zero pad, length padme(6 + payload_len).

InnerPadding.description: Unknown comp, non-zero rsv or pad, or a length other than padme(6 + payload_len), is Padding.

InnerLimit.description: payload_len up to 2^20 is allowed; above it is Limit, checked before the length.

CheckOrder.description: Two faults at once: the first check in the order of the rules decides.

Compress.description: One single-segment zstd frame at level 3 with its content size, no checksum, no dictionary ID and window_log 20; equal output is only expected from the zstd version in the header.

StoreRaw.description: The frame is kept only if 16 × frame ≤ 15 × chunk; otherwise the chunk is stored with comp 0. A reader refuses a comp 1 payload that breaks the rule as Decompress, before its frame is checked, so each chunk has one encoding.

SecretRaw.description: Chunks of secret-class objects are never compressed; a secret chunk with comp 1 is Padding.

FrameOk.description: Frames FS-53 allows decode to exactly plain_len bytes, as libzstd 1.5.7 decodes them; a reader on another decoder must give the same results, and crypthix-core's own Decompressor requires 1.5.7. Raw, RLE and literals-only frames are built by hand.

FrameRejected.description: A frame that is not exactly one single-segment frame with content size plain_len in the shortest field that holds it, no checksum, no dictionary ID and the unused and reserved bits clear, that is cut off, or whose content differs from its declaration, is Decompress.

BlockSize.description: A block larger than min(window, 128 KiB), where a single segment's window is plain_len and an RLE block counts the bytes it regenerates, is Decompress, though libzstd 1.5.7 decodes such a frame in one pass.

PlainLenCap.description: plain_len may be 2^20; above that the chunk is Decompress before it is decrypted or decoded.

DataBlobSeal.description: Seal(K_chunk, aad, inner, hedged nonce) with the AAD of FS-55; K_chunk and K_blobid from the DEK and dek_salt (FS-38).

KeyedBlobId.description: In an ordinary object of two or more chunks, blob_id = MAC(K_blobid, chunk), checked after opening.

RandomBlobId.description: In a single-chunk or secret-class object, blob_id is random and not recomputed.

DataBlobOpen.description: A data blob opens to its chunk.

AadBinding.description: A blob sealed under an AAD naming another vault, object, DEK, blob ID, kind or label, or under another key, is Decrypt.

BlobIdBinding.description: A blob that opens but whose chunk does not MAC to its keyed blob ID is Binding.

BlobInner.description: A data blob whose inner plaintext is malformed is Padding, or Limit for payload_len over 2^20.

BlobFrame.description: A data blob whose payload is not exactly plain_len bytes when raw, or does not decode to exactly plain_len bytes when compressed, is Decompress.

SealShape.description: Input too short to be a seal is Truncated; an all-zero nonce is ZeroValue.

MetaBlob.description: Seal(K_kind_e, aad, CBOR, hedged nonce) with the AAD of FS-57; GC-candidate nodes use the location key.

MetaBlobOpen.description: A meta blob opened with another kind byte, epoch, blob ID, vault or KEK is Decrypt.
